data.description:
## Description
**What**: Extend mutation-testing.yml with Ruby (mutant), JS/TS (Stryker --incremental), and Go (go-gremlins) parallel matrix jobs alongside the Python pilot; Flask is covered by the Python job.
**Why**: Delivers the polyglot informational-mode increment; completes the shippable Phase 1-2 release gate.
**Scope**:
- IN: per-stack tool install pinned to mutation.<stack>.tool_version with mutation.<stack>.fallback_versions chain; per-stack runtime cap via mutation.<stack>.timeout_seconds (Stryker 600, mutmut 900, mutant 1200, gremlins 900); partial-result emission with runtime_exceeded=true on timeout; matrix fail-fast false; ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT prominent warning with no bug ticket and aggregate_kill_rate=null when every stack times out; aggregate job merges all stack findings into one PR comment; dso-config.conf default keys for the new stacks.
- OUT: calibration auto-surfacing; threshold enforcement; onboarding/setup integration.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the workflow runs Ruby (mutant), JS/TS (Stryker --incremental), and Go (go-gremlins) as parallel matrix jobs with fail-fast false, each installing its tool at mutation.<stack>.tool_version with a mutation.<stack>.fallback_versions chain ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, a stack that exceeds mutation.<stack>.timeout_seconds emits a partial findings result with runtime_exceeded=true rather than failing the job ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, when every stack returns runtime_exceeded=true the PR comment surfaces an ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT warning, aggregate_kill_rate is null, and no bug ticket is created ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, the aggregate job merges all stack findings into a single PR comment using the MUTATION_TESTING_FINDINGS_<pr-number> marker ← Satisfies: sc-3
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (per-stack timeout partial-result emission, ALL_STACKS_TIMEOUT aggregation, multi-stack merge) ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Cost] Three additional matrix jobs multiply per-PR CI minutes; per-stack timeout caps and the concurrency group from draft-1 bound the worst case.
- [Correctness] Monorepo incremental-mode diff scoping is a documented limitation (mutmut on shared packages); do not attempt to mitigate within this story.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want Ruby, JS/TS, and Go mutation jobs added as parallel matrix entries, so that polyglot PRs report per-stack kill-rate telemetry with timeout safety.
